quests.title: Staffy Near the brick kilns
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at the brick kilns at three in the morning. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Everyone in St Peters has definitely seen it and can't say where. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near the brick kilns
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: Tap On at the brick kilns
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. My Opal says I owe nineteen dollars for a trip from St Peters I never took on Friday. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Take the same one to Marrickville and tell me what it charged you. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: tap on at St Peters, tap off at Marrickville
come back and tell me the fare

quests.title: One Stop From the Princes Highway
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. I need to know the train from St Peters stops at Marrickville and doesn't sail through like it did on Anzac Day. You will see what I mean the second you get there. Ride it at eleven and photograph the sign. I would rather know than wonder.

quests.title: The the Princes Highway Sparky
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The sparky off the the Princes Highway job has owed me since the bathroom and drinks in St Peters from three in the morning. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Forty will do and I'll write off the rest. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: find the sparky who owes for the Princes Highway

quests.title: The King Street south end Lift
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. The lift at St Peters station has been out since the Easter Show and I'm told Marrickville is worse. I am aware how that sounds. Check both Wednesday and tell me which takes a pram. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: check the lift at St Peters station
then ride to Marrickville and check theirs

quests.title: Trolley Run, King Street south end
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. A Woolies trolley from King Street south end gets walked to the creek every Anzac Day. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Find where it ends up in St Peters and make the deposit back. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: find the trolley near King Street south end

quests.title: Race Four, the Camdenville oval
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. There's a horse in race four at five that a bloke at the Camdenville oval swears by. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in St Peters and tell me if it came in. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: tell me if it came in
